vibe_rationale: Street art core with murals, live painting and workshops, but little evidence of community depth or curation, and the festival is on hiatus.
fit_notes: No audience profile is recorded and street art crowds often skew young, so the adult fit is unverified. A commissioned wall or live art collaboration suits a culture-led brand, but 2026 was cancelled and the 2027 return is withdrawn, so any role depends on a return.
